department: School of Engineering — Department of Computer Science and Engineering

deadline.value: Fall 2027-28 non-local full-time deadline is June 1, 2027 (rolling admissions; local full-time deadline July 15, 2027; HKPFS deadline December 1, 2026; separate early recruiting round closed August 15, 2026).
deadline.quote: For 2027/28 Fall Term Intake (commencing in Sep 2027): | Non-local Applicants* | Full-time: 1 Jun 2027 | Local Applicants | Full-time: 15 Jul 2027 | Admissions is on rolling basis.

also.quote: Applications will be processed on a continuous basis as they arrive until positions are filled. You are thus recommended to apply as soon as possible.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for computer science (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: CSE FAQ recommends contacting faculty members after submitting an application, and notes a recommendation/support letter from a prospective faculty supervisor strengthens admission.
supervisor.quote: Yes, you are encouraged to contact faculty members whom you are interested in working with.

funding.value: University guideline states all full-time RPg students should be funded 12 months/year via Postgraduate Studentship (HK$229,620/yr centrally), fellowships, TAships, or RAships; HKUST considers PGS suitability at application review.
funding.quote: The current university guideline is that all full-time research PG students should be funded 12 months a year. The studentship support can come from the supervisor, the department, the school, and/or the university, and can be in the form of Fellowship, Teaching Assistantship or Research Assistantship.

also.quote: HKUST will consider the suitability of candidates to receive the PGS while reviewing their application for research postgraduate programs.
Postgraduate Studentship (PGS) | HK$229,620 per year (~US$29,420/ year) | Up to 4 years for full-time PhD students

entry_route.value: Admits bachelor's holders with outstanding performance (4-year full-time PhD) and research master's holders (3-year full-time PhD).
entry_route.quote: Full-time: 3 years (with a relevant research master’s degree), 4 years (without a relevant research master’s degree) | Applicants seeking admissions to a doctoral degree program should have obtained a bachelor’s degree with a proven record of outstanding performance from a recognized institution

notes: CSE research spans Artificial Intelligence (ML, NLP, Vision, Robotics), Data Science (Databases, HCI, Theoretical CS), and Systems & Networking; early recruiting round for 2027-28 closed August 15, 2026 while regular phase maintains reserved quotas.
